Title: Improved browser interactions for Azure preview portal

Body.Content:
The following list itemizes improved Browse resources experiences for the Azure preview portal added in April 2015:
  • Access all resources in a single list (All resources view)
  • Filter resources by subscription
  • Filter resources by name
  • Customize the columns in your resources list
  • Pin your resource lists to the Startboard for quick and convenient access
  • More control over the Recent browse list
For more information, see Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (April Update). The following list itemizes improved browser interactions in February 2015:
  • Browser Back button support (preview)
  • Text selection in blade headers
For more information, see Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (February Update). Here is a list of improved browser interactions we made for the portal in January 2015:
  • Open blade in new tab
  • Open blade in new window
For more information, see Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (January Update).
